# Capability catalogue

What a product feature can build on: the public contracts, the domain events, the capabilities, the quotas, the plans and the types they use. After `by`, the status is the implementing component's: NOT IMPLEMENTED means no running code serves the contract yet.

## Public contracts (3)

id: name | in name:type (? optional) | out | err | needs capabilities | auth scheme | idem | by component (status)

- archive-post: Archive a post | in - | out - | err forbidden | needs - | auth service | idem no | by none
- publish-post: Publish a post | in post:post-id, tags?:list\<tag\> | out state:post-state | err forbidden,not-found | needs post-write,post-publish | auth session | idem yes | by worker (NOT IMPLEMENTED)
- read-post: Read a post | in post:post-id | out post:post | err - | needs post-read | auth anonymous | idem yes | by gateway (manual)

## Domain events

The events of a tenant's event log (`domain: true`); a product module subscribes to these. Machine events are left out.

- post-archived: -
- post-published: post:post-id, change:change

## Capabilities

id [core]: description | roles that hold it

- post-publish: Make a post visible. | -
- post-read [core]: Read posts. | owner,reader
- post-write [core]: Create and change posts. | owner

## Quotas

id: limit per window, on exceed

- q-read-post: 100 per 15 min, refuse

## Plans

- enterprise: Quotas set by contract. | adds post-publish

## Types

- change: none|retitle(string)|move{to:post-id}
- post: {id:post-id, state:post-state, tags?:list\<tag\>}
- post-id: id string
- post-state: draft|published|archived
- tag: scalar string
